item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, edge-to-edge, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that imagines cognition through competing rhythms of accumulation, interruption, revision, and release. Use a deep ultramarine ground with translucent layers of smoky violet and mineral gray. Concentrate dense, restless brushwork slightly off-center: short vermilion strokes, scraped ivory pigment, and thin acidic yellow gestures that repeatedly gather, diverge, and disappear beneath later layers. Let some marks hesitate or double back; let others cut decisively across thick impasto. Contrast this compressed activity with broad areas of pale, cool, nearly empty space, softly stained by earlier color. Establish spatial tension through unequal weights, interrupted repetitions, partially erased passages, and unexpected intervals of stillness. Preserve material texture: dry bristle drag, palette-knife ridges, exposed underpainting, wet pigment bleeding into matte fields. Avoid a single focal point or tidy resolution; make attention travel through changing densities and unfinished gestures. Entirely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The painting fills the entire square image, with no border, frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}
